rationale: The accrual leg is internally inconsistent with its own hypothesis — adding xrd to ib but not to oancf makes SUB(ADD(ib,xrd), oancf) equal accruals *plus* R&D spend, so the NEG term mechanically penalizes R&D-intensive firms rather than measuring whether "R&D-adjusted earnings are cash-backed," and the underlying value×accrual-quality interaction is close to the published Sloan-accruals/value combination.

This is essentially the published intangible-adjusted book-to-market (Eisfeldt–Kim–Papanikolaou "Intangible Value," Lev–Sougiannis capitalization) with goodwill stripped out, and the archive already tested the same economic content in InternalKnowledgeBookValueQuality, so it is a direct rediscovery rather than a new cross-theme signal.

This is a mechanical splice of two archived signals — the exact additive structure and value leg of PersistentPreRDEarningsValue with the NEG(DELTA(xrd/sale)) amplifier already tested (and found alpha-neutral) in MatureRDCheapness — i.e., a cosmetic variant rather than a substantive new mechanism.

The numerator change is a real modification, but subtracting dividends economically penalizes exactly the higher-quality, higher-payout value firms that typically drive earnings-yield premia, and the R&D-stock amplifier is a re-run of the component that already failed in SelfFundedKnowledgeCashValue, so the hypothesis's "retained reinvestment" logic is not well matched to the expected sign.

This is a third pass at the same expensive-plus-goodwill short-leg idea already tested twice in the archive (AcquisitionIntangibleOverpayRisk, GoodwillProductivityPremiumRisk), with only the third leg swapped from productivity decline to low cash-flow-to-assets, and the triple rank multiplication concentrates the extremes into an unstable, essentially low-profitability/high-valuation portfolio already spanned by known profitability-value effects.

Deliberately *not* adding back R&D and instead conditioning conventional earnings yield on the hidden-capital share of adjusted book equity is a substantively different test from the archive's add-back family, the additive structure keeps ordinary value firms in the long leg, and the sign direction follows naturally from the expression — though the reviewer should watch that the amplifier does not simply proxy for R&D intensity's own return effect.
